identity.name: RM 67-02 Automatic Extra Flat

case.material: Carbon TPT or Quartz TPT composite

identity.one_liner: An extra-flat automatic built for continuous wear during sport, reinforced through the bezel geometry rather than added case thickness, and among the lightest watches Richard Mille produces.

provenance_events.description: Richard Mille releases the 32-gram RM 67-02 sports watch with the automatic CRMA7 calibre.

narrative.story: The RM 67-02 line, debuting in 2016, addressed a different problem than Richard Mille's tourbillon halo pieces: a watch light and thin enough to wear through an entire athletic event without being noticed. Reinforcement comes from four case extensions integrated into the bezel rather than from added thickness, which is how the watch stays extra-flat while meeting Richard Mille's shock-resistance targets. The collection has continued through multiple color and ambassador editions since its debut, including a 2022 update.
narrative.collector_notes: Ambassador and limited-run colorways (tied to specific athletes Richard Mille sponsors) carry different scarcity than the standard-run TPT composite editions; buyers confirm which specific colorway and edition size a listing refers to before comparing prices.
